import fasttext
import os
import time

print('Training on non-lowercased data: dim=10, epoch=5, lr=0.1')
start = time.time()
model = fasttext.train_supervised(
    input='/app/work/train.txt',
    dim=10,
    bucket=200000,
    wordNgrams=2,
    epoch=5,
    lr=0.1,
    minCount=2,
    thread=4,
    verbose=2
)
print(f'Training time: {time.time()-start:.1f}s')

model.save_model('/app/work/model_nolower.bin')
print(f'Model size: {os.path.getsize("/app/work/model_nolower.bin")/1024/1024:.2f} MB')

result = model.test('/app/work/test.txt')
print(f'Non-lowercased test - samples: {result[0]}, accuracy: {result[1]:.4f}')

# Also test on lowercased test to see robustness
result2 = model.test('/app/work/test_lower.txt')
print(f'Lowercased test - samples: {result2[0]}, accuracy: {result2[1]:.4f}')
